home.docTitle: JuHeGui - Pre-launch Compliance Pre-check for AI Short Dramas & Comic-dramas
home.heroBadge: Mandatory filing · AI labeling per episode · Four-party liability — the compliance line before launch
home.heroDesc: JuHeGui is a compliance pre-check SaaS for AI short dramas, built for the latest NRTA regulations: episode-by-episode detection across 8 violation categories with line-level localization, plus compliance self-checks, filing material generation, and hash-sealed evidence — all in one place, turning policy guesswork into a standard, billable workflow.

features.title: Script compliance pre-check
features.desc: Episode-by-episode scanning across 8 violation categories: child-harmful content, soft-porn innuendo, money-worship and flaunting wealth, distorted views on marriage, feudal dross, violent revenge, vulgar titles, and IP infringement. Every hit ships with the legal basis, a confidence score, and rectification advice.

features.title: Filing material generation
features.desc: Generates the three-piece filing kit — work info sheet, script synopsis, and cost breakdown — following each platform's self-review templates, with explicit prompts for missing fields and annotated tiering for AI-produced dramas.

features.title: Evidence & audit trail
features.desc: Every pre-check report carries a SHA-256 content hash, generation timestamp, and rule-library version, so each conclusion can be traced back to the exact regulatory baseline in effect at the time.

home.painsDesc: With regulation tightening, compliance is no longer a post-launch fix — it's a question you must answer before submission.

pains.title: Regulation fully tightens in 2026
pains.desc: New NRTA rules are in force: mandatory short-drama filing, per-episode AI labeling, and four-party liability across platforms and producers. The room to launch first and patch later is gone — non-compliant content is stopped at the review gate.

pains.title: The real cost of takedowns and rejections
pains.desc: A takedown sinks production cost, ad spend, and release slots; a single platform rejection raises the trust cost of future deals. Most causes — borderline dialogue, AI-spoofed classic IP, missing AI labels — can all be caught before launch.

pains.title: Pre-check makes compliance routine
pains.desc: Pre-launch checking turns policy interpretation into a billable, standardized scan: get the hit list and rectification advice before you submit, fix, then submit — spend your time creating, not reworking.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: From script pre-check to filing delivery — the full pre-launch compliance chain for AI short dramas and comic-dramas.

sections.title: 8 violation categories
sections.desc: Compliance detection for AI short dramas aligned with the latest NRTA rules, covering child-harmful content, soft-porn innuendo, money-worship, distorted marriage views, feudal dross, violent revenge, vulgar titles, and IP infringement. Scripts are scanned episode by episode; every hit ships with legal basis, confidence, and rectification advice — turning review from guesswork into a report.

sections.title: Line-level localization (with timecodes)
sections.desc: Hits are pinpointed to the exact episode and line of dialogue; full-cut detection adds subtitle timecodes so editors and writers can fix at the point instead of reworking whole episodes — cutting the rectification loop from days to hours.

sections.title: AI-spoof detection (classic IP × spoof co-occurrence)
sections.desc: Built-in libraries of classic IP elements and high-risk adaptation patterns: when both co-occur in a script, it is flagged as an AI-spoof risk. Three-channel matching (keyword, semantic, scene fingerprint) reduces misses, with the applicable regulatory baseline attached.

sections.title: AI labeling checks
sections.desc: Aligned with the mandatory per-episode AI-labeling requirement: verifies that AI-generated-content labels on cuts and posters are compliant, prominent, and present on every episode, outputting a missing-label list and fix suggestions to avoid platform rejection.

sections.title: Copyright self-check
sections.desc: Scene deduplication and license-chain records: fingerprint-matching of dialogue and scenes flags similarity risks against known works, while IP licensing materials are recorded — a complete copyright self-check in one pass.

sections.title: Platform-specific calibration
sections.desc: Check the same script against the baselines of Hongguo Short Drama, Fanqie Novel, Kuaishou Xingmang, and WeChat mini-program dramas to compare differentiated hits. Filing and approval strategies are tuned per platform — one detection, reused everywhere.

sections.title: Filing kit & agency tracking
sections.desc: Generates the three-piece kit (work info sheet, script synopsis, cost breakdown) per platform self-review templates, with explicit prompts for missing fields and annotated AI-drama tiering. Agency filing progress is trackable — no more WeChat-group relay.

sections.title: Analytics dashboard
sections.desc: Team-level views of submission volume, hit distribution, rectification rate, and violation-category trends — helping content leads see which genres cross lines most and turning compliance experience into reviewable data.

sections.title: Open API
sections.desc: An open API (POST /api/v1/detect) embeds AI short-drama compliance detection into your production pipeline and internal systems, with unlimited calls on annual plans. See the docs page for curl examples and field reference.

sections.title: Custom rule library
sections.desc: Layer team-defined rules on top of the universal library: proprietary red-line words, genre-specific no-go zones, and client-mandated baselines can all be configured as detection rules — versioned and effective independently of the official library.

sections.title: Hash-sealed reports (SHA-256 + rule version)
sections.desc: Every report carries a SHA-256 content hash, generation timestamp, and rule-library version, so conclusions can be traced back to the exact baseline in effect — credible evidence for internal reviews and disputes.

sections.title: Rectification re-check & diff
sections.desc: Re-check a script in one click after fixes; the re-check is automatically linked to the original report. Hit differences are grouped as resolved / persisting / new, making rectification impact obvious at a glance.

sections.title: Free title check
sections.desc: No sign-in required: scans titles and promo copy against the NRTA title-review baseline and returns a risk verdict, legal basis, and renaming advice in seconds — de-risk your title before submission.

sections.title: Filing guide wizard
sections.desc: No sign-in required: determines the key / standard / other micro-drama tier from work type and investment, then outputs the filing path, AI-labeling duties, and materials checklist — no more guessing which channel to file through.

sections.title: GB 45438 labeling self-check
sections.desc: An explicit/implicit AI-labeling checklist aligned with the GB 45438-2025 national standard: verify font height, opening frame, display duration, and metadata fields item by item, with progress saved locally.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.intro: This document covers the JuHeGui quick-start flow, decision-baseline explanation, open API integration, and rule-library versioning.

quickSteps.t: Click "Sign in" at the top right to enter the dashboard; new accounts get 3 free script pre-check credits.
Click "New submission" in the dashboard, enter the work title, and choose the target platform baseline (Hongguo / Fanqie / Kuaishou / WeChat mini-program drama, or the universal baseline).
Paste the full script into the text box (keep "Episode X" markers for line-level localization) and submit for detection.

Once complete, review the overall verdict and each hit — every hit includes episode number, line-level position, legal basis, confidence, and rectification advice; each report is hash-sealed with SHA-256 and the rule version.

docs.triChannelDesc: The detection engine jointly decides across three channels: keyword matching ensures high-risk red lines are never missed, semantic matching catches rewrites and variants, and scene-fingerprint matching detects structural plagiarism and AI-spoof co-occurrence.
docs.confDesc: Every hit includes a 0–1 confidence score and the corresponding regulatory basis. Prioritize rectification by severity, then confidence.

severities.t: Any single hit makes the whole work high-risk; it must be rectified before submission.
A confidence-weighted verdict; rectification is recommended before submission.

Then pick the original report in the "Re-check comparison" block: hit differences are grouped as resolved / persisting / new, with the verdict change of both reports shown on top.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions about AI short-drama compliance pre-checks, platform baselines, data security, and billing.

items.q: Does a JuHeGui pre-check guarantee approval?
items.a: No. JuHeGui provides pre-launch compliance references; every conclusion includes a confidence score and legal basis to help you find and fix high-risk content early. Final approval is subject to platform and regulatory review, and baselines marked "industry interpretation" defer to the original NRTA texts.

items.q: Which platform review baselines are supported?
items.a: A universal baseline is built in, with platform-specific calibration for Hongguo Short Drama, Fanqie Novel, Kuaishou Xingmang, and WeChat mini-program dramas. The same script can be checked against each platform baseline to compare hits.

The system maintains a co-occurrence library of classic IP elements and spoofed plot patterns, and matches scripts across three channels (keyword, semantic, scene fingerprint). When classic IP elements co-occur with high-risk adaptation patterns, it is flagged as an AI-spoof risk with legal basis and rectification advice.

items.q: Is my script data safe? Will it be retained or leaked?
items.a: Frame sampling of full cuts is hashed locally and original files are retained minimally; script text is used only for the current detection and report generation. Reports are sealed with a SHA-256 hash and rule version, traceable to the exact baseline at the time.

items.q: How does billing and activation work?
items.a: Sign up to get 3 free trial checks. Script pre-checks are ¥800–1,500 per title, full cut + filing kit ¥2,000–4,000 per title, team subscriptions ¥1,500–4,000 per month, and API annual plans ¥200K–600K per year. No in-platform payment — leave your contact on the pricing page and our team activates your plan one-on-one.

items.q: How often is the rule library updated?
items.a: The rule library rolls forward with NRTA regulation updates and platform baseline changes, each update producing a new rule version. Historical reports can be traced back via the rule version recorded on them; team subscribers get priority updates.

items.q: How do I apply for the open API?
items.a: After signing in, create a key yourself on the "API Keys" page (starting with jhg_) to call POST /api/v1/detect. Each key is rate-limited to 60 requests/minute and counts against your plan quota. For unlimited calls or private deployment, choose "Enterprise API Annual" on the pricing page and our team will set it up with you.
